rows.label: UK
rows.html: PM Keir Starmer resigned 22 Jun (Labour leadership contest concludes by 16 Jul, Andy Burnham the frontrunner). FTSE 100 near record highs, +2.27% over 4 weeks on miners/financials/blue-chips; FTSE 250 edged lower — miners, housebuilders (class-action overhang) and BAT dragged on domestic mid-caps. 10yr gilt yield fell from a May high near 5.19% to ~4.71–4.85% as political risk eased — a tailwind for gilt/bond funds.

rows.label: US
rows.html: Choppy — a Fed-hawkish-hold selloff hit tech/Mag7 names hard around 16–24 Jun (memory-chip oversupply fears, OpenAI IPO delay reports), before a late-June AI-trade reassessment rally clawed back much of the move (S&P 500 +1.18%, Nasdaq +2.07% on 29 Jun alone).

rows.label: Europe

rows.label: Asia / EM

rows.label: Commodities
rows.html: Gold fell ~10.5–11.6% over the month — its 4th consecutive monthly decline and worst quarter in decades — on Fed-hawkish rate expectations. A real headwind for gold-miner-heavy holdings (e.g. Artemis Global Income's Kinross Gold, Agnico Eagle, Freeport-McMoRan positions).
